infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SnapTheFee uses the camera to photograph receipts and verify credit card surcharges.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SnapTheFee accesses your photo library so you can upload receipt photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SnapTheFee uses your location to show nearby NYC businesses and their card surcharge policies.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow SnapTheFee to access your photos to upload receipt evidence.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow SnapTheFee to use your camera to snap receipt photos.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow SnapTheFee to center the map on your NYC neighborhood.
